builder_plan.change: Check whether a released student model fits the task before generating training data.

steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Student quality, serving cost, teacher calls, training cost, and failures on unusual inputs.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: SkillCore: Internalizing Generalizable Skills via Scaffolding-Removed Fine-Tuning
summary: SkillCore replaces runtime skill loading—external procedural guidance injected into agent prompts—with supervised fine-tuning on agent trajectories whose skill-loading scaffolding has been removed, so the model executes the procedures directly. The cost is building a trajectory transformation and mixing pipeline plus an SFT run (feasible for an 8B model on a 24 GB GPU with parameter-efficient methods, harder for 72B), and the quality risk of baking skills into weights that must be refreshed as procedures change. Failure modes include catastrophic forgetting of general coding ability if the scaffold-removed-to-skill-native mixture ratio is wrong, loss of task-specific skill invocation, and internalized procedures becoming stale or inapplicable on out-of-distribution tasks.
rationale: Internalizing procedural skills removes a prompting dependency, but the gain depends on having or generating real agent trajectories, so the reader should validate the data pipeline on their own task distribution before committing fine-tuning budget.
